_comment: Search profiles for scripts/samgov_watch.py and keyword lists for scripts/bidnet_watch.py. Edit here, not in code. SAM.gov fields: title (keyword), ncode (NAICS), ccode (PSC/FSC), state (place of performance). exclude_keywords veto a match. bonfire_orgs = Euna/Bonfire portal subdomains (<org>.bonfirehub.com) to scan.

brownbison.label: Brown Bison Holdings — HVAC / plumbing / electrical / landscaping / facilities

jones-bearing.label: Jones Bearing Co. dba American Pulley / ConveyMor (Luke's dad) — MANUFACTURER: bucket elevators, hot lime handling, bearings, pulleys

company_facts.legal_name: Jones Bearing Company (trade names American Pulley, ConveyMor)
company_facts.hq: Pelham, Alabama; manufacturing in Leeds, Alabama

products.Jones Bearing: mounted spherical roller bearings and take-ups (S2000, Type E, SAF, flange, piloted flange); 1000 Series tapered roller bearing pillow blocks
products.American Pulley: conveyor pulleys, shafting, bushings, bearings, power-transmission components
products.ConveyMor: bucket elevators, drag and apron conveyors, lump breakers, lime proportioners, kiln feed screws

company_facts.model: Build and sell product. NOT a service/maintenance contractor. Target supply/purchase solicitations and parts buys, not repair contracts.
company_facts.uei_cage: UNKNOWN — ask Luke/dad. Required to quote on SAM.gov and DLA DIBBS.
company_facts.core_per_luke_2026-10-19: Bucket elevators and hot lime handling equipment are the core. (Luke wrote 'hot line'; read as hot LIME, consistent with ConveyMor lime proportioners and kiln feed screws. Confirm.)

jones-bearing._states_note: Nationwide: products ship. Place of performance is irrelevant for supply buys.
jones-bearing._codes_note: PSC 3110 antifriction bearings; 3130 mounted bearings (pillow blocks, take-ups); 3020 gears/pulleys/sprockets; 3030 belting/drive belts; 3910 conveyors; 3920 material handling equipment (non-self-propelled); 3950 winches/hoists/cranes. NAICS 332991 ball & roller bearing mfg; 333922 conveyor & conveying equipment mfg; 333613 mechanical power transmission equipment mfg; 423840 industrial supplies wholesalers. PSC 4610 water purification equipment (lime slakers/feeders at water & wastewater plants, a federal buyer of lime handling gear: Corps of Engineers, Bureau of Reclamation, military installations).

other_sources.DLA DIBBS: https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil — where most DLA bearing/pulley/conveyor-part buys post (RFQs by FSC 3110/3130/3020/3910). Viewable without login; quoting needs CAGE + DIBBS registration. Primary source for this profile, not SAM.gov.
other_sources.GSA eBuy: Needs a MAS contract. Longer play.
other_sources.Paper mills (commercial, not government): Paper mills are private; their bearing/conveyor buys are not on bid portals. That is a sales-prospecting job (Apollo/HubSpot), not a bid-watch job.
other_sources.Water/wastewater plants: Hot lime handling buyers are water & wastewater utilities (lime softening, slaking), cement/lime plants, steel mills, pulp & paper. Municipal utilities DO post on BidNet/RMEPS and state portals: add 'lime' keyword to all municipal watches.

jones-bearing.bid_model: Brown Bison primes where a bid needs a registered contractor; Jones Bearing supplies/subcontracts the equipment (bucket elevators, lime handling, bearings, pulleys). Flag any Brown Bison-profile bid whose scope includes conveyors, elevators, or lime systems as a joint pursuit.
